verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֣חַ עַל־ שֹׁ֭שַׁנִּים לִבְנֵי־ קֹ֑רַח מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל שִׁ֣יר יְדִידֹֽת׃ רָ֘חַ֤שׁ לִבִּ֨י׀ דָּ֘בָ֤ר ט֗וֹב אֹמֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי מַעֲשַׂ֣י לְמֶ֑לֶךְ לְ֝שׁוֹנִ֗י עֵ֤ט׀ סוֹפֵ֬ר מָהִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ ‘a·lō·šō- šan·nîm liḇ·nê- qō·raḥ maś·kîl šîr yə·ḏî·ḏōṯ rā·ḥaš lib·bî dā·ḇār ṭō·wḇ ’ō·mêr ’ā·nî ma·‘ă·śay lə·me·leḵ lə·šō·w·nî ‘êṭ sō·w·p̄êr mā·hîr
verses.literal: For the choirmaster To the tune of The Lilies A Maskil of the sons of Korah A love song My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer
verses.literalPt: De boas palavras trasborda o meu coração. Repito o que compus no tocante a um rei. A minha língua é pena de escritor expedito.

verses.original: יָפְיָפִ֡יתָ מִבְּנֵ֬י אָדָ֗ם ה֣וּצַק חֵ֭ן בְּשְׂפְתוֹתֶ֑יךָ עַל־ כֵּ֤ן בֵּֽרַכְךָ֖ אֱלֹהִ֣ים לְעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: yā·p̄ə·yā·p̄î·ṯā mib·bə·nê ’ā·ḏām hū·ṣaq ḥên bə·śə·p̄ə·ṯō·w·ṯe·ḵā ‘al- kên bê·raḵ·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: You are the most handsome of men . . . grace has anointed your lips therefore . . . God has blessed you forever . . .
verses.literalPt: Tu és mais formoso do que os filhos dos homens; sobre os teus lábios está derramada a graça. Por isso, Deus te abençoou para sempre.

verses.original: חֲגֽוֹר־ חַרְבְּךָ֣ עַל־ יָרֵ֣ךְ גִּבּ֑וֹר ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ וַהֲדָרֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḡō·wr- ḥar·bə·ḵā ‘al- yā·rêḵ gib·bō·wr hō·wḏ·ḵā wa·hă·ḏā·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Strap your sword at your side O mighty warrior appear in your majesty and splendor
verses.literalPt: Cinge a tua espada, ó grande herói, cinge a tua glória e a tua majestade.

verses.original: וַהֲדָ֬רְךָ֨׀ צְלַ֬ח רְכַ֗ב עַֽל־ דְּבַר־ אֱ֭מֶת וְעַנְוָה־ צֶ֑דֶק וְתוֹרְךָ֖ נוֹרָא֣וֹת יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḏā·rə·ḵā ṣə·laḥ rə·ḵaḇ ‘al- də·ḇar- ’ĕ·meṯ wə·‘an·wāh- ṣe·ḏeq wə·ṯō·wr·ḵā nō·w·rā·’ō·wṯ yə·mî·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice may your right hand show your awesome deeds
verses.literalPt: Na tua majestade monta prosperamente, pela causa da verdade, da mansidão e da justiça, e a tua destra te ensinará coisas terríveis.

verses.original: חִצֶּ֗יךָ שְׁנ֫וּנִ֥ים עַ֭מִּים תַּחְתֶּ֣יךָ יִפְּל֑וּ בְּ֝לֵ֗ב אוֹיְבֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥiṣ·ṣe·ḵā šə·nū·nîm ‘am·mîm taḥ·te·ḵā yip·pə·lū bə·lêḇ ’ō·wy·ḇê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes the nations fall beneath your feet
verses.literalPt: As tuas setas são agudas (Os povos caem debaixo de ti.) no coração dos inimigos do rei.

verses.original: כִּסְאֲךָ֣ אֱ֭לֹהִים עוֹלָ֣ם וָעֶ֑ד שֵׁ֥בֶט מִ֝ישֹׁ֗ר שֵׁ֣בֶט מַלְכוּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kis·’ă·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·w·lām wā·‘eḏ šê·ḇeṭ mî·šōr šê·ḇeṭ mal·ḵū·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Your throne O God endures forever and ever and justice is the scepter of Your kingdom
verses.literalPt: O teu trono, ó Deus, é pelos séculos dos séculos; e cetro de equidade é o cetro do teu reino.

verses.original: אָהַ֣בְתָּ צֶּדֶק֮ וַתִּשְׂנָ֫א רֶ֥שַׁע עַל־ כֵּ֤ן׀ מְשָׁחֲךָ֡ אֱלֹהִ֣ים אֱ֭לֹהֶיךָ שֶׁ֥מֶן שָׂשׂ֗וֹן מֵֽחֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·haḇ·tā ṣe·ḏeq wat·tiś·nā re·ša‘ ‘al- kên mə·šā·ḥă·ḵā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā še·men śā·śō·wn mê·ḥă·ḇê·re·ḵā
verses.literal: You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness therefore . . . God your God has anointed you above your companions with the oil of joy
verses.literalPt: Amaste a justiça e odiaste a iniquidade. Portanto, Deus, o teu Deus, te ungiu com o óleo de alegria acima dos teus companheiros.

verses.original: מֹר־ וַאֲהָל֣וֹת קְ֭צִיעוֹת כָּל־ בִּגְדֹתֶ֑יךָ מִֽן־ הֵ֥יכְלֵי שֵׁ֝֗ן מִנִּ֥י שִׂמְּחֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mōr- wa·’ă·hā·lō·wṯ qə·ṣî·‘ō·wṯ kāl- biḡ·ḏō·ṯe·ḵā min- hê·ḵə·lê šēn min·nî śim·mə·ḥū·ḵā
verses.literal: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad
verses.literalPt: Todas as tuas vestes cheiram à mirra, aloés e cássia. De palácios de marfim soam instrumentos de cordas que te alegram.

verses.original: בְּנ֣וֹת מְ֭לָכִים בְּיִקְּרוֹתֶ֑יךָ נִצְּבָ֥ה שֵׁגַ֥ל לִֽ֝ימִינְךָ֗ בְּכֶ֣תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nō·wṯ mə·lā·ḵîm bə·yiq·qə·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā niṣ·ṣə·ḇāh šê·ḡal lî·mî·nə·ḵā bə·ḵe·ṯem ’ō·w·p̄îr
verses.literal: The daughters of kings are among your honored women the queen stands at your right hand adorned with the gold of Ophir
verses.literalPt: Filhas de reis estão em o número das tuas queridas; à tua mão direita está a rainha, ataviada de ouro de Ofir.

verses.original: שִׁמְעִי־ בַ֣ת וּ֭רְאִי וְהַטִּ֣י אָזְנֵ֑ךְ וְשִׁכְחִ֥י עַ֝מֵּ֗ךְ וּבֵ֥ית אָבִֽיךְ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘î- ḇaṯ ū·rə·’î wə·haṭ·ṭî ’ā·zə·nêḵ wə·šiḵ·ḥî ‘am·mêḵ ū·ḇêṯ ’ā·ḇîḵ
verses.literal: Listen O daughter Consider and incline your ear Forget your people and your father’s house
verses.literalPt: Ouve, filha, considera e inclina o teu ouvido; esquece-te do teu povo e da casa de teu pai.

verses.original: וְיִתְאָ֣ו הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ יָפְיֵ֑ךְ כִּי־ ה֥וּא אֲ֝דֹנַ֗יִךְ וְהִשְׁתַּֽחֲוִי־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiṯ·’āw ham·me·leḵ yā·p̄ə·yêḵ kî- hū ’ă·ḏō·na·yiḵ wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wî- lōw
verses.literal: and the king will desire your beauty bow to him for he is your lord
verses.literalPt: Assim, o rei desejará a tua formosura, pois ele é o teu Senhor; presta-lhe tu homenagem.

verses.original: וּבַֽת־ צֹ֨ר׀ בְּ֭מִנְחָה פָּנַ֥יִךְ יְחַלּ֗וּ עֲשִׁ֣ירֵי עָֽם׃
verses.literal: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift men of wealth will seek your favor
verses.literalPt: A ti virá com donativos a filha de Tiro; os mais ricos do povo suplicarão o teu favor.

verses.original: כָּל־ כְּבוּדָּ֣ה בַת־ מֶ֣לֶךְ פְּנִ֑ימָה מִֽמִּשְׁבְּצ֖וֹת זָהָ֣ב לְבוּשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- kə·ḇū·dāh ḇaṯ- me·leḵ pə·nî·māh mim·miš·bə·ṣō·wṯ zā·hāḇ lə·ḇū·šāh
verses.literal: All glorious is the princess in her chamber . . . her gown is embroidered with gold
verses.literalPt: Toda esplêndida está a filha do Rei lá dentro do palácio; a sua vestidura é recamada de ouro.

verses.original: לִרְקָמוֹת֮ תּוּבַ֪ל לַ֫מֶּ֥לֶךְ בְּתוּל֣וֹת אַ֭חֲרֶיהָ רֵעוֹתֶ֑יהָ מ֖וּבָא֣וֹת לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: lir·qā·mō·wṯ tū·ḇal lam·me·leḵ bə·ṯū·lō·wṯ ’a·ḥă·re·hā rê·‘ō·w·ṯe·hā mū·ḇā·’ō·wṯ lāḵ
verses.literal: In colorful garments she is led to the king her virgin companions . . . are brought before you
verses.literalPt: Em vestidos bordados é ela conduzida ao Rei. As virgens, suas companheiras que a seguem, serão trazidas à tua presença.

verses.original: תּ֭וּבַלְנָה בִּשְׂמָחֹ֣ת וָגִ֑יל תְּ֝בֹאֶ֗ינָה בְּהֵ֣יכַל מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tū·ḇal·nāh biś·mā·ḥōṯ wā·ḡîl tə·ḇō·’e·nāh bə·hê·ḵal me·leḵ
verses.literal: They are led in with joy and gladness they enter the palace of the king
verses.literalPt: Serão conduzidas com alegria e regozijo; entrarão no palácio do Rei.

verses.original: תַּ֣חַת אֲ֭בֹתֶיךָ יִהְי֣וּ בָנֶ֑יךָ תְּשִׁיתֵ֥מוֹ לְ֝שָׂרִ֗ים בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā yih·yū ḇā·ne·ḵā tə·šî·ṯê·mōw lə·śā·rîm bə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Your sons will succeed . . . your fathers you will make them princes throughout the land
verses.literalPt: Em lugar de teus pais, serão teus filhos, a quem farás príncipes por toda a terra.

verses.original: אַזְכִּ֣ירָה שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־ דֹּ֣ר וָדֹ֑ר עַל־ כֵּ֥ן עַמִּ֥ים יְ֝הוֹדֻ֗ךָ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ’az·kî·rāh šim·k̲ā bə·ḵāl dōr wā·ḏōr ‘al- kên ‘am·mîm yə·hō·w·ḏu·ḵā lə·‘ō·lām wā·‘eḏ
verses.literal: I will commemorate your name through all generations . . . therefore . . . the nations will praise you forever and ever
verses.literalPt: Farei que seja lembrado o teu nome em todas as gerações, porquanto te darão graças os povos para todo o sempre.
